Name: AOBI Master Chef - English
Author: InkofArtemis
Description:
This is the English translation for [b]AOBI Master Chef [/b]by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/211893702]lunadeemo[/url]. I thought the recipes and sprites were super cute and wanted to use them in my game. Keep in mind I do not know a thing about the AOBI game itself so I don't really understand any references if they were made.

I'm Chinese but American-born and I cannot read a lick of it (other than the numbers) so I used my own spotty Chinese knowledge, common sense, and a translator to put this together. If someone with better knowledge of the Chinese language spots something off, please let me know and I'll fix it. So far, I've tested it in the game and everything seems okay.


[b][size=3]INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS:[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Download the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33999?tab=description]original[/url]﻿ mod here.
[*]Extract the original mod into your Mods folder.
[*]Download my translation.
[*]Extract it to the Mods folder.
[*]Replace existing files when asked.
[*]Play the game!
[/list]
